interpretation_rules: Within a priority group, the baseline has no ranking information and its tie allocation equals expected uniform random selection.
Within a priority group, area, dwelling type and bedrooms are constant. The property-only model can distinguish listings only using recorded amenity count.
Fixed per-group quotas sum rounded group allocations and can exceed the rounded pooled quota. Compare models only within the same allocation design.
The ablation removes price and minimum-stay settings together and refits other coefficients. It does not identify separate effects or causal interventions.
The prior selection of groups and features remains outside this evaluation. Repeated host splits do not provide an untouched test of that selection process.
